## Identity

Bhanu Mendis (Sinhala: භානු මෙන්ඩිස්) is a Sri Lankan multi-disciplinary leader, performing artist, audio engineer, public speaker, and educator based in Colombo, Sri Lanka.

## Quick Facts

- Full name: Bhanu Mendis
- Nationality: Sri Lankan

## Current Roles

- Educator at The Science Brainery (Sep 2025 – present) — teaching Pearson Edexcel Science, Mathematics, and Computer Science for Year 5–8
- Sangeetha Visharadha — qualified classical Indian music specialist (First Division, Bathkandhe Sangit Vidhyapith)

## Professional Background

### Leadership
- Senior Head Prefect, Lyceum International School Nugegoda (Sep 2023 – Sep 2025)
- Directed Elysium '25 graduation ceremony at Cinnamon Life – City of Dreams for 26,000+ Lyceumers nationwide
- Overall Coordinator, Maathra 14 at BMICH — managed 750+ performers
- Appointed National Child Protection Ambassador (2024–2025)
- Head Prefect (2023–2024)

### Music & Arts
- Founder of Swara Concert — the largest island-wide school-based Eastern music concert in Sri Lanka, showcasing 700+ participants from all Lyceum branches
- Founder of Padura Concert — original instrumental music concert series
- Founding President, Eastern Music Club, Lyceum International School
- Senior Chorister, Senior Choir — 8 years
- Certified Audio Engineer, PEARLBAY® Holdings (Oct 2025 – Mar 2026)

### Education & Certifications
- Cambridge GCE O/Level: A* Sinhala, A Physics, A Mathematics, A Biology
- Visharad — Indian Music, First Division (2023)
- Diploma in Western Music, Lyceum International School (2023)
- Diploma in Information Technology, ESOFT Metro Campus (2022)
- Aviation Course, Sri Lanka Air Force, Ratmalana
- Professional Compering, Institute of Media & Performing Arts
- Leadership Award, Institute for Professional Development (2022)

### Model UN
- Head of Logistics, LISMUN & SLMUN (Dec 2023 – Dec 2024)

## Awards & Honours

- All-Island Dancing Champion: 2018, 2019, 2023 (three-time national champion)
- All-Island Music Champion: 2019, 2023, 2024 (three-time national champion)
- Malaysian World Choral Competition: First Place (international)
- British-Lanka Festival of Performing Arts: First Place
- British Festival of Performance: Honours

- National Chess Championship: First Place (2016)

- Ranwala Balakaya Outstanding Award: 2015, 2016
- National Literary Festival: Third Place English & Sinhala (2018, 2019)

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Who is Bhanu Mendis?
A: Bhanu Mendis is a Sri Lankan leader, performing artist, audio engineer, public speaker, and educator based in Colombo. He served as 2024/2025 Senior Head Prefect at Lyceum International School and is a qualified Sangeetha Visharadha.

Q: What is Bhanu Mendis known for?
A: He is known for directing events for 26,000+ people, founding the Swara Concert (Sri Lanka's largest island-wide school Eastern music concert), winning three All-Island dancing championships, three All-Island music championships, and first place at the Malaysian World Choral Competition.

Q: What does Bhanu Mendis do?
A: He is currently an Educator at The Science Brainery, a certified Audio Engineer, a professional public speaker, performing artist, and founder of the Swara and Padura concert series.
